explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration for this. The theorem states that a vector of the library's own principal-series carrier `PSCarrier p μ₁ μ₂` is zero if its function `toFn` vanishes at every `lowerUnip p y` and at `weyl p`. `PSCarrier`, `toFn`, `lowerUnip` and `weyl` are all defined in the library, not in Mathlib. The proof only applies the library's own lemma `ext_cells`. Mathlib has no theory of principal-series representations of GL₂(ℚ_p), so no declaration there could state this result; for that reason I did not run a further search.
